# 00000000411

**SA-11 ★** — source: 20_代数组合与对称函数.md

**English.** Definition: Skew Schur functions s_{λ/μ}. Conjecture: Two skew shapes yield the same skew Schur function if and only if their difference belongs to the equivalence class generated by "edge flips" (a directional conjecture on the classification of skew Schur functions, verifiable up to |λ/μ| ≤ 8).

**中文。** 定义：斜 Schur 函数 s_{λ/μ}。猜想：两斜形状给出同一斜 Schur 函数 ⟺ 形状差为"边翻转"等价类(斜 Schur 分类问题的方向性猜想,可验证至 |λ/μ| ≤ 8)。
